title: The Gospel Trumpet Announces the Supper at Bethany
english: Let us listen, beloved. Even now the sacred trumpet of the gospels proclaims good news to the Church of God. And what does it add for the joy of the faithful? Let us make this the crown of our discourse and a guide for what follows. John the evangelist, the son of thunder, who drew unutterable mysteries from the all-bearing field of wisdom, the heart of the Lord, says: “Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, the one who had died, whom he raised from the dead. So they made him a supper, and Martha served, while Lazarus was among those reclining with him.”
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG 18 Homilia christologica in Lazarum u01-open
orientation: The homily opens by quoting John the Evangelist's account of the supper at Bethany, where Lazarus, raised from the dead, reclines at table with Jesus while Martha serves.
